artworks.title: Saint Catherine of Alexandria (Saint Catherine d'Alexandrie)
artworks.description: The image shows a seated woman, two child-like figures resembling cherubs, and a bird-like figure. The woman is leaning slightly to her right, looking at one of the cherubs. She has delicate facial features and medium-length wavy hair, dressed in a draped garment. The background is textured with dense lines, and a bird-like figure appears above. The cherubs have wings, with one emitting a glowing aura. The image is monochromatic and sketched with intricate lines.

artworks.title: The Goatherd (Le chevrier)
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral landscape from a low vantage point. The horizon is in the middle, separating the sky from the land. A cluster of buildings is visible on the horizon, resembling a village or castle. The drawing is detailed with precise linework for texture on trees, land, and structures. It is monochrome with warm gray shades. Goats are resting on the grass in the foreground, and tall trees with intricate cross-hatching leaves are on the right. Hills and a spacious landscape extend towards the sky in the background.

artworks.title: Europa and the Bull (L'enlèvement d'Europe)
artworks.description: The image displays a detailed scene featuring ships docked along a body of water with trees on either side. The color palette is monochromatic, focusing on shades of sepia and dark lines. People, animals, and cattle are visible on the shore, while ships and structures fill the background.

artworks.title: Ruine d'une Gallerie Antique de Rome
artworks.medium: color etching and wash manner on laid paper
artworks.description: The image portrays an architectural ruin with stone columns stretching into the distance on both sides. Greenery and sky are visible between the columns and large wooden beams cast shadows. The brushstrokes are delicate, adding texture to the stone, wood, and foliage. Earthy tones dominate the color palette, along with subtle blues and greys for atmosphere. Figures in period clothing are near a horse, and birds soar in the distance. A decorative urn is on a plinth to the right.

artworks.title: Ruine de la partie Interieure d'une Basilique de Rome
artworks.medium: color etching and wash manner on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a grand, classical architectural ruin with people gathered around a fire inside. The painting depicts an interior view of an ancient basilica, showcasing massive stone pillars and arches that draw the eye upward toward the ceiling, which features intricate, coffered designs. In the foreground, there are a number of large, wooden barrels and pieces of broken masonry. Smoke rises from a fire where a few figures sit, implying a camp or gathering in this ruined space. Natural light filters through openings in the structure, creating contrasts of light and shadow.

artworks.title: Courtyard of a Castle
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene of medieval architecture with fine line work in a monochromatic color palette. The drawing shows a town with rolling hills, buildings with pitched roofs, a central tower, a tree, a fortress wall with an arched door, a ladder, and a path leading into the distance.

artworks.title: Landscape with Sail Boats
artworks.description: The image shows a coastal landscape with small sailing boats in the water. The viewpoint is elevated, showing the coastline, water, and a distant town or village at the horizon. There are buildings with domes and towers along the horizon, with hills behind them. On the left are rocky outcrops with buildings and vegetation, while on the right, a tall cliff rises above the sea with a fortress-like structure. The etching uses fine lines of varying density to depict texture and depth, with a monochromatic color palette highlighting pen strokes and shading for contrast and realism.

artworks.title: Emperor Charles V
artworks.medium: etching (iron), with open biting, plate bitten twice
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 22.8 x 15.8 cm (9 x 6 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image is an engraving with a profile portrait of a man facing left. The man has a prominent nose, slightly parted lips, medium-length straight hair, and a cap with a leafy motif. He wears ornate clothing with a luxurious collar. Surrounding the portrait is a circular frame with the inscription "CAROLVS REX CATHOLICVS." The background features an elaborate decorative border with patterns, cherubs, mythical creatures, and foliate designs.

artworks.title: Chute de Staubbach, dans la Vallée de Lauterbrunnen (Falls at Staubbach in the Lauterbrunnen Valley)
artworks.medium: etching and wash manner, printed in blue, red, yellow, and black inks
artworks.dimensions:
sheet (trimmed within platemark): 29.9 x 45 cm (11 3/4 x 17 11/16 in.)
overall (outer framing line): 23.2 x 32.1 cm (9 1/8 x 12 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a valley surrounded by cliffs and waterfalls, viewed from an elevated perspective. The cliffs, waterfalls, greenery, trees, river, and sky are detailed with fine brushstrokes using earthy tones. Figures and wooden structures are visible in the foreground.

artworks.title: Vue de Thun du Cote du Midi
artworks.description: The image shows a scenic view of Thun with a perspective looking towards a medieval town. The horizon is high, showcasing the town's buildings and castle above the landscape. Delicate and precise brushstrokes highlight details in the architecture and foliage. A bridge crosses a calm body of water reflecting the structures and sky. Tree-lined banks lead to the town in the distance. The color palette is soft and harmonious, with muted pastels and earthy tones. The sky is pale blue with hints of pink and grey.

artworks.title: Rape II (Raub II, Weib halb)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two abstracted figures intertwined. The image features two figures in a simple, outlined form. The lines are loose and fluid, almost sketch-like. The image is monochrome. The lack of detailed features or background keeps the focus on the abstract forms of the figures themselves.

artworks.title: Don Mariano Camprubi (Le Bailarin)
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a man in full-body view. He is standing upright, facing slightly right with his left hand on his hip and his right hand hanging at his side. His facial features are distinct with a serious expression, and he has short, curly hair. The man is dressed in an elaborate costume resembling a traditional matador's outfit, adorned with detailed embroidery and patterns. Over his left shoulder, he carries a draped cape. He wears ballet flats that complement his formal attire. The background consists of evenly spaced horizontal lines.

artworks.title: Christ Among the Doctors
artworks.artist: Israhel van Meckenem after Hans Holbein the Elder
artworks.description: The image shows several figures gathered in an interior setting. A central figure, seated on a raised platform, is joined by a group of older individuals dressed in robes. The central figure has long, wavy hair and is wearing a robe-like garment. They have an open book on their lap, with one hand on a bookstand. Surrounding them are the older individuals, some seated or standing in attentive postures. A small table in front of them holds various objects, including a scroll and books. A dog is curled up on the tiled floor near the table. In the background, gothic architectural elements like arches and columns can be seen, with additional figures near a staircase leading to another room. The setting has a serene and scholarly atmosphere, with intricate patterns and detailed shading characteristic of engraved artwork.

artworks.title: Saint Margaret
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing in a slightly angled position. She wears long robes with intricate folds and drapery, and has long, wavy hair flowing down her shoulders. Her face is serene with delicate features. She holds an object in one hand and gestures with the other. A dragon-like creature is coiled at her feet with a scaly texture and expressive face. The background is plain, with a visible ground line.

artworks.title: The Rape of Europa
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 17.9 x 12.6 cm (7 1/16 x 4 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with figures, architecture, and natural elements. A woman is sitting on a bull with a crown of leaves, while another woman stands next to them conversing with a man holding a staff. In the background, there is a castle near water, with mountains in the distance. The ground has vegetation, a tree, and a tree stump. The drawing style is detailed and intricate, reminiscent of early Renaissance engravings.

artworks.title: Landscape with Horseman and Three Travelers
artworks.description: The image features a landscape view from an elevated perspective. A group of trees fills the left side of the composition, while a distant cityscape with tall buildings and towers is visible along the high horizon. The color palette is monochromatic, focusing on varying tones of sepia. The sky above contains swirling clouds that contrast with the darker shades below.

artworks.title: Landscape with a Bridge and Two Fishermen
artworks.medium: etching, with touches of drypoint, on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features a rustic wooden bridge as the central focus. Two figures are on the bridge, with a calm waterway below and a small boat to the left. A large tree is on the left of the bridge, adding depth. In the distance, low structures and a few trees define the horizon. The sky above has faint cloud formations. The artwork is characterized by intricate etching techniques with a monochromatic color palette of black on cream or sepia-toned paper.

artworks.title: Knife Fight Among Peasants
artworks.medium: etching, with touches of drypoint, on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of four figures in a small, dimly lit room. Two of them are engaged in a disagreement, one gesturing with a raised fist. Another figure seems to be trying to intervene, while the fourth figure sits by a window with arms raised defensively. The room has textured walls and exposed timber framing, with natural light coming in through the window. The drawing is detailed, depicting a tense and dynamic moment.

artworks.title: Knifegrinder at Work Outside a Cobbler's Workshop
artworks.medium: etching, with touches of drypoint, on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a person sharpening a tool with a grinding wheel outside a rustic building. The scene features intricate line work, capturing a detailed outdoor setting. The central focus is on the person sharpening the tool. They are wearing heavy clothing relevant to older times. The building next to them has an archway and a small window. Additional figures and nature elements in the background contribute to the village-like atmosphere. The artist's signature is visible in the drawing.

artworks.title: Man and Woman Conversing in Front of an Inn
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals engaged in conversation. One person is depicted from behind, wearing a bonnet and a dress with long sleeves. The other person is facing forward, wearing a wide-brimmed hat and a cloak. The person on the right has slightly aged facial features and is holding a basket. The background includes trees, a small building, and a cloudy sky. The scene is illustrated with detailed lines and shading.

artworks.title: Man and Woman Conversing on a Busy Village Street
artworks.medium: etching, with touches of drypoint, on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two full figures, a woman and a man, standing outdoors. The woman is carrying a basket and wearing a long dress, headscarf, and apron. The man is holding a long stick or walking stick and wearing a long coat and hat. The background includes a thatched roof cottage, a tree, a figure near a water feature, and a small dog. The scene is depicted with intricate lines and textures.

artworks.title: Peasants Outside a Farm Slaughtering a Pig
artworks.medium: etching, with touches of drypoint, on laid paper
artworks.description: This image depicts a group of individuals around an animal in an outdoor setting by a cottage. The scene includes a tree, a house, and the figures in a circle, engaging in cleaning or preparing the animal. Light and shadow are used to highlight their actions and details. The drawing showcases fine line work and attention to detail in the figures and the environment.

artworks.title: Village Schoolmaster with Three Pupils
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 9 × 8.1 cm (3 9/16 × 3 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group gathered around a table. The interior setting features a man with a large hat sitting in a chair near a table with papers or documents spread out. Surrounding the table are three younger figures engaged in an activity. The room is detailed, with a textured ceiling, and a small window letting in light. There is a small framed picture or document hanging on the wall next to the seated figure. The drawing captures a moment of collaboration or instruction.

artworks.title: Street Vendor Selling Spectacles at the Door
artworks.medium: etching, with touches of drypoint, on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 10.2 × 8.7 cm (4 × 3 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: This image shows three individuals in a rural setting. One person is standing facing left, wearing a wide-brimmed hat and a cloak, holding a basket. Another person is inside a doorframe, wearing a cap and loose garments. A third individual is seen from behind, dressed in a long garment and hat, possibly observing. The background includes a rural building with wooden beams, a door, and a window, along with rustic elements like a wooden bench or fence.
